🧠 Clinical Rationale: The saliva contains an enzyme that begins the breakdown of starch into sugar, which is why a piece of bread tastes sweet when it is chewed for a while

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — vitamins: Vitamins are not digested in this way at all

C — proteins: Proteins begin to be digested in the stomach

D — fats: Fats are digested mainly in the small intestine

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: The nurse gives a patient with a sore mouth soft, well cooked starchy food, because the digestion of starch begins in the mouth and a patient who cannot chew well leaves much of it undigested

question: The part of the brain that controls the body temperature and thirst is the:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. hypothalamus

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The hypothalamus lies below the thalamus and controls the temperature, the thirst, the hunger and the sleep

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — cerebellum: The cerebellum keeps the balance and the smooth working of the muscles

C — cerebrum: The cerebrum governs thought and voluntary movement

D — medulla oblongata: The medulla controls the heart rate and the breathing

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: The nurse understands why a patient with a head injury can become very hot, because the part that holds the temperature steady is inside the skull and small changes there affect the whole body

question: The largest lymphoid organ in the human body is the:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. spleen

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The spleen is the largest lymphoid organ and takes part in the defence of the body and in the life of the blood cells

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — tonsil: The tonsils are small masses in the throat

C — thymus: The thymus is a lymphoid organ of childhood and is smaller than the spleen

D — lymph node: A lymph node is small and there are many of them

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: The nurse watches for a swelling in the left upper abdomen with a fall in the blood counts, because an enlarged spleen holds and destroys the blood cells

question: The unit of frequency is the:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. hertz

🧠 Clinical Rationale: Frequency is the number of vibrations or waves in a second, and the unit is the hertz

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — newton: The newton is the unit of force

C — second: The second is the unit of time

D — metre: The metre is the unit of length

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: The nurse knows that the monitor reading of the heart rate is a frequency, and that a reading of sixty on the monitor means sixty beats in the minute

question: The exchange of gases and of the dissolved food takes place through the walls of the:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. capillary

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The capillaries are the finest vessels, with walls one cell thick, and it is through them that the gases and the food pass to and from the tissues

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — heart: The heart pumps the blood and does not exchange the gases

C — vein: A vein returns the blood and does not exchange the gases

D — artery: An artery has a thick wall and carries the blood away from the heart

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: The nurse understands why the colour of the skin and the nail beds is examined, because a poor flow in the capillaries is seen there first as pallor or a bluish tinge

question: The greatest volume of air that a person can breathe out with effort after the deepest breath in is called the:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. vital capacity

🧠 Clinical Rationale: The vital capacity is the largest volume a person can breathe out after the deepest possible breath in

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — total lung capacity: The total lung capacity includes the residual volume as well

C — tidal volume: The tidal volume is the small volume moved in and out in quiet breathing

D — residual volume: The residual volume is the air left in the lungs that cannot be breathed out

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: The nurse watches the chest expansion and the ability to blow out a candle, because a falling vital capacity is an early sign of a chest that is becoming weak

question: The defect of vision in which distant objects appear blurred is called:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. myopia

🧠 Clinical Rationale: In myopia, or short sight, the image falls in front of the retina and distant objects look blurred, and it is corrected by a concave lens

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — cataract: A cataract is a clouding of the lens and not a defect of its power

C — hypermetropia: In hypermetropia the near objects are blurred and a convex lens is needed

D — astigmatism: Astigmatism is an uneven curvature that blurs the image in certain directions

⚠️ Exam Trap: Beware near-sounding options and units - define the quantity before choosing.

💎 PNC Pearl: The nurse who notices a child holding a book close or screwing the eyes up sends him for a vision check, because a child who cannot see the board falls behind at school and is often wrongly thought to be dull

question: A patient is ordered 500 mg of a drug four times a day. The total dose in a day is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 2 g

🧠 Method: Four doses of 500 mg give 2,000 mg, which is two grams in the day

⚡ Fast Approach: Substitute into the standard formula and keep the units consistent.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 4 g: Four grams would be eight doses of 500 mg

C — 2.5 g: Two and a half grams would be a different schedule

D — 1 g: One gram would be only two doses

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Work out the dose for the whole day as well as the single dose, because the daily total is what tells whether the order is within safe limits

question: In a hospital of 500 staff, 40 per cent are nurses. The number of nurses is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. 200

🧠 Method: Ten per cent of 500 is 50, so forty per cent is 50 multiplied by 4, which is 200

⚡ Fast Approach: Break the percentage into easy parts (10 percent, 5 percent, 1 percent) and add them.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — 300: 300 would be sixty per cent

C — 150: 150 would be thirty per cent

D — 250: 250 would be fifty per cent

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Take ten per cent first, because ten per cent of any number is found by moving the decimal point one place

question: The average of 6, 12, 18 and 24 is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 15

🧠 Method: The total is 60 and there are four values, so 60 divided by four gives 15

⚡ Fast Approach: Total = average x number of items. Find the total first, then subtract the known values.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 20: 20 is above the true average

B — 18: 18 is another of the values

C — 12: 12 is one of the values

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Add the values and count them before dividing, because dividing before the total is complete is the commonest slip in an average

question: The simple interest on 8,000 rupees at 5 per cent per year for two years is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. 800 rupees

🧠 Method: Principal times rate times time divided by hundred gives 8,000 multiplied by 5 multiplied by 2 and divided by 100, which is 800 rupees

⚡ Fast Approach: SI = P x R x T / 100. Keep T in years - convert months to a fraction.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — 1,600 rupees: 1,600 rupees would need four years at this rate

C — 1,200 rupees: 1,200 rupees would need three years at this rate

D — 400 rupees: 400 rupees is the interest for one year

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Keep the time in years in the formula, because the interest for a period given in months must be converted before the multiplication

question: Four nurses can finish a job in fifteen days. At the same rate, six nurses will finish it in:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 10 days

🧠 Method: Four nurses working fifteen days give sixty nurse days of work, and divided among six nurses this comes to ten days

⚡ Fast Approach: Combine rates as 1/A + 1/B, then invert to get the number of days.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 12 days: 12 days is more than the time six nurses need

C — 8 days: 8 days would need seven and a half nurses

D — 20 days: 20 days is more than the time four nurses take, which is impossible

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Trick: Work out the total work in nurse days first, because the total work in such a sum never changes however many people share it

question: A drug is supplied as 250 mg in 5 mL. The volume needed for a 400 mg dose is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. 8 mL

🧠 Method: Five millilitres contain 250 mg, so each millilitre holds 50 mg, and 400 mg needs eight millilitres

⚡ Fast Approach: Write down what is given and what is asked before calculating.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 5 mL: 5 mL would give only 250 mg

B — 10 mL: 10 mL would give 500 mg

D — 12 mL: 12 mL would give 600 mg

⚠️ Exam Trap: Check the dose, route and timing before choosing - the right drug in the wrong dose is a wrong answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Find the amount in one millilitre first and then divide the dose by it, because the amount in one millilitre is the figure that makes every dose from that bottle easy to work out

question: A bottle of 500 mL is to be given over six hours with a set that gives 20 drops per mL. The rate is about:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. 28 drops per minute

🧠 Method: Five hundred multiplied by twenty gives 10,000 drops, and divided by 360 minutes this is about 28 drops a minute

⚡ Fast Approach: Write down what is given and what is asked before calculating.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — 40 drops per minute: 40 drops a minute would finish the bottle in about four hours

C — 20 drops per minute: 20 drops a minute would take more than eight hours

D — 50 drops per minute: 50 drops a minute would finish it in under three and a half hours

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Divide the total volume by the total hours first and then convert into drops, because converting first and dividing afterwards invites a slip in the decimal point

question: Find the odd one out: mango, apple, banana, potato.
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. potato

🧠 Method: Mango, apple and banana are fruits, while potato is a vegetable that grows under the ground

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw the circles of the given sets and see which conclusion is certain.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — banana: Banana is a fruit

C — apple: Apple is a fruit

D — mango: Mango is a fruit

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Name the property that the first three share in one word before choosing, because the odd one out is the item that does not answer to that single word

question: Complete the series: 4, 7, 12, 19, ?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. 28

🧠 Method: The differences between the terms are three, five and seven, so the next difference is nine and 19 plus 9 gives 28

⚡ Fast Approach: Check the differences first, then squares, cubes or multiplication.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 26: 26 would need a difference of seven again

B — 30: 30 would need a difference of eleven and break the odd-number pattern

C — 27: 27 would need a difference of eight

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Write the differences below the terms before choosing, because a series that looks irregular is usually a simple pattern of differences that is easy to see once it is written down

question: If A is 1, B is 2 and so on, the total value of the word CAB is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: c. 6

🧠 Method: C is 3, A is 1 and B is 2, and the three together give 6

⚡ Fast Approach: Compare the first and last letters of the given pair to find the shift.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 8: 8 would need a letter that is not there

B — 7: 7 would make one of them worth one more

D — 5: 5 would make one of the letters worth one less

⚠️ Exam Trap: Read the stem twice - one word such as MOST or EXCEPT can reverse the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Write the number under each letter before adding, because adding the letters in the order they are read is where the slip usually occurs

question: A girl walks five kilometres towards the north and then turns to her right and walks three kilometres. She is now facing:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: a. east

🧠 Method: Walking north and turning right brings her to face the east, and the distance walked does not change the direction she faces

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw a small diagram - each turn changes the direction by a fixed angle.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

B — north: North is the direction before the turn

C — south: South is the turn in the opposite direction

D — west: West would be the left turn from the north

⚠️ Exam Trap: Do not pick an option only because it is familiar - the option that fits the whole stem is the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Note whether the question asks for the direction faced or the distance from the starting point, because the two are quite different and the answer turns on which one is asked

question: M is the mother of N. N is the son of O. How is O related to M?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. husband

🧠 Method: M is the mother of N and O is the father of N, so O is the husband of M

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw the family tree and mark the given relations before answering.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — brother: A brother would not be the father of her child

C — father: O is the father of N and not of M

D — son: A son of M would be a brother of N

⚠️ Exam Trap: Look for the qualifier (FIRST / BEST / MOST LIKELY) - it decides the answer.

💎 PNC Trick: Draw the tree with each person in his or her own place before answering, because a relation that is read in the wrong direction gives an answer that sounds reasonable and is quite wrong

question: In a row of 40 students a boy is fifteenth from the left end. His position from the right end is:
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: b. 26th

🧠 Method: The position from the right is the total plus one minus the position from the left, so 40 plus 1 minus 15 gives 26

⚡ Fast Approach: Positions add up to one more than the total number in the row.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — 27th: 27 would need 14 from the left

C — 25th: 25 would need 16 from the left

D — 24th: 24 would need a position of 17 from the left

⚠️ Exam Trap: Be careful with absolute words such as ALWAYS and NEVER unless the fact is truly absolute.

💎 PNC Trick: Remember that the two positions count the same person twice, and add the one before subtracting

question: All nurses are graduates. All graduates are degree holders. Which of the following follows?
solution:
✅ Correct Answer: d. All nurses are degree holders

🧠 Method: If every nurse is a graduate and every graduate holds a degree, then every nurse must hold a degree

⚡ Fast Approach: Draw the circles of the given sets and see which conclusion is certain.

❌ Why Not Other Options?

A — Some nurses are not graduates: It contradicts the first statement

B — All degree holders are nurses: Reversing the statement does not follow, since all degree holders need not be nurses

C — No graduate is a nurse: It also contradicts the first statement

⚠️ Exam Trap: In FIRST-action questions, identify the life-threatening problem and stabilise or assess before anything else.

💎 PNC Trick: Draw two circles, the smaller inside the larger, before deciding, because a statement that is true in one direction is very often false when it is quietly reversed
